# Updates

- Added a no-API ToC workflow: copy selected ToC pages as images (batch or one-by-one), copy a ready-to-paste vision prompt, and import the web AI JSON answer.
- Added optional export of selected ToC pages into a `tmppage` subfolder; after a successful ToC apply, only `tmppage` contents are cleaned up (folder preserved).
- Added an old vs new ToC side-by-side comparison modal before overwriting an existing ToC.
- Increased API-based ToC generation limits to 20 pages / 10MB.
